answer.text: Camping had the most product fault tickets this year with 262, followed by Safety Equipment (174) and Workwear (147). Hand Tools (130) and Power Tools (125) come next, and Generators had the fewest (36).
assumptions: This year = year to date, 2026-01-01 to 2026-10-27
Product fault = ticket_category 'Product fault', all regions

sql.sql:
select p.category as product_category, count(*) as tickets_opened
from marts.fct_tickets as t
inner join marts.dim_product as p on p.product_key = t.product_key
where t.opened_date between %(start_date)s and %(end_date)s and t.category = any(%(filter_0)s)
group by 1
order by 2 desc nulls last
limit %(row_limit)s
